sahneler.metin: A mine waste dam in British Columbia suddenly breached.
Within hours, water and mine waste rushed into nearby lakes and creeks.
The dam itself wasn't the weak point.
Beneath it lay a thin layer of glacial clay.
Site investigations had not identified how weak it was.
As the dam grew steeper, the clay sheared.
The foundation slid, and the dam opened.
British Columbia strengthened tailings dam requirements.

aciklama:
Mount Polley breached and released mine waste into lakes. The cause: foundation failure through an undetected weak glaciolacustrine clay layer.
